content: If bathing in the river could bring salvation, the frogs and fish would be the first to enter heaven.
author: Kabir
explanation: Kabir uses sharp satire against superstition: physical water washes only the outer skin. True spiritual cleansing is the baptism of consciousness in truth and love.
practicalInsight: Do not rely on outward symbolic gestures for peace of mind. Bring real ethical transformation to your actions today.
reflectionPrompt: Which of my spiritual habits has degraded into an empty, mechanical ritual?
